description.value: The GVPL Saanich Centennial Library Branch is part of the Greater Victoria Public Library system, which operates branches across the greater Victoria region on southern Vancouver Island. Public libraries offer a quiet, climate-controlled environment with public computers and programming open to all visitors. This branch is wheelchair accessible and serves the broader Saanich community.
